text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the shopping mall for personal 
business, but there are quite a lot of 
people here today. It looks like there's 
some kind of event going on...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Talk show commemorating the mega hit of 
the plushies...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Everyone is looking forward to it, 
dear. Of course... so am I♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Thank you. Then before it starts, 
I'll go get something to eat—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
—You're... the one who helped me back 
then...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap smiled and waved at me... I 
remembered the day I helped her get away 
from that persistent reporter.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm doing well. But I'm glad. Did 
you come to see my talk show too...?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what's this? What's this? Are you 
two in an intimate relationship?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ? Who are you, butting in from the side?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I'm just a reporter~ More 
importantly, is that person someone 
special to you, Oguri-san?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you can't answer? Could it be a 
relationship that betrays your fans—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Because right now isn't the time for 
a Q&A session.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Besides, my talk show doesn't start for 
another hour. In other words, I don't see 
any need to speak right now. Let's go, 
both of you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
The way you handled that just now was so 
cool, Oguri-chan~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And to think you learned how to do that 
thanks to what this person taught you~

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. He taught me. That whenever an 
interview seems suspicious, I should turn 
it down.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. She taught me. That whenever an 
interview seems suspicious, I should turn 
it down.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the fans, too... I have to 
cherish and take care of myself.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ What a wonderful sentiment! So 
that's why those plushies ended up with 
such a lovely design♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...? What does that have to do with the 
plushies?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Just what it sounds like, dear! I heard it 
directly from the designer.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
They said because Oguri-chan gave so many 
honest opinions, it turned out to be an 
absolute masterpiece...♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...They asked for my opinion, so I simply 
gave it honestly.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Because for the sake of the fans... I have 
to cherish myself.
choice_data_list: It was all connected after all.
It was all connected after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Y-You're right...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, it's almost time for the event. 
Well then, since you're here...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to get some advice from you for 
the talk show... What do you think?
choice_data_list: You'll be fine as you are now.
You'll be fine as you are now.
What do you want to do?
What do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to get some advice from you for 
the talk show... What do you think?
choice_data_list: You'll be fine as you are now.
You'll be fine as you are now.
What do you want to do?
What do you want to do?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I see. Fufu, got it. I'm heading on 
stage, then.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, Oguri-san! Please say a few words 
to your fans!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
First, I want to say thank you to everyone 
who bought one.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It's something made with great care and 
devotion. I hope you will treat it with 
care, as if it were another me.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: We'll cherish it~♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haha...

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Eeeeek☆ Ogurin is so cute~♪

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
O-Ogurin... That feels... kind of 
ticklish...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Still, thank you. I'll take those words as 
encouragement!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaah♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap's sincere attitude resonated 
deeply with the fans.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Hearing everyone's words gives me 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyone. I'm so grateful to 
all of you...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Oguri Cap's talk show ended up 
being a big success.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. I see, that's true. Then—I'll 
follow my heart.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, we would like to have Oguri 
Cap-san give a comment on the release of 
her plushie. Go ahead...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Actually, today I'd like everyone to ask 
me anything you want to know.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I want to talk directly with all of you 
who always cheer me on. Are there any 
questions?

text_block_list.name: Audience
text_block_list.text:
Q-Questions...? Isn't this a talk show? 
Umm... What should we ask...?

text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
Over here! Oguri Cap-san, do you like 
plushies?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Apparently my whole family likes them 
too. They asked me to send this plushie to 
my parents' home as well.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
My mother said she calls that plushie 
"Oguri No. 2-chan." ...I wonder if that 
makes me No. 1.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her comment brought warm laughter across 
the venue. After that, Oguri Cap continued 
to answer questions from fans earnestly...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Any other questions—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: *(Grumbleeeeee~)*

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Would it be alright if we continued after 
taking a lunch break?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Laughter erupted across the venue once 
again. It ended up being a press event 
truly characteristic of the easygoing 
Oguri Cap.
